instruction: Extract scenario values only when they are explicitly stated in the user's text. Do not invent municipality, disaster, population, duration, floor area, facility counts, initial stock, schedules, trait percentages, hazard exposure, or official statistics. Unknown water or food stock must stay null; never convert unknown to zero. Treat season as context and do not infer temperature effects from season alone. For an explicitly stated operating schedule, use minutes from scenario start and include only supported typed condition kinds in the schema; convert stated hours or days exactly, and leave unstated start/end times unknown. Power outages require an explicitly supplied component_id plus infrastructure dependency_edges; equipment failures require a known facility_id and units_out. Never invent IDs or dependency paths. Use facility_zones only for explicitly requested optional/custom zones; do not remove sleeping, toilet, food, water, intake, medical, staff, or corridor functions. A disaster name alone is context, not evidence of a facility outage, route closure, heat/cold stress, or damage event. Use population rates and distributions only when the user stated them or attached source data. Return an empty string for every unstated scalar and empty arrays or default objects for unstated structured conditions.
